questions.q: The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 by:
questions.why: W. C. Bonnerjee presided over the first session in Bombay.

questions.q: Lt Stanzin Tsangyang, commissioned from OTA Chennai in September 2026, became the first woman Army officer from which district?
questions.why: She is from the Zanskar valley of Ladakh. Sep 2026.

questions.q: The humanoid robot to fly on Gaganyaan's first uncrewed mission (G1) is named:
questions.why: ISRO completed crew-module and service-module separation tests at VSSC. Oct 2026.

questions.q: Who was the chief guest at Goa's Statehood Day celebrations held at Kala Academy, Panaji, on 30 May 2026?
questions.why: Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan attended on his first official visit to Goa. May 2026.

questions.q: In September 2026 Goa Police launched an AI-based call agent that registers complaints in many languages for which helpline?
questions.why: Announced when Amit Shah presented the President's Colour to Goa Police. Sep 2026.

questions.q: Dr B. R. Ambedkar called which Article the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution?
questions.why: Article 32 gives the right to constitutional remedies.

questions.q: Exercise MAITREE-XV, held at Surat Thani from 18 to 31 August 2026, is an army exercise between India and:
questions.why: It focuses on counter-terrorism and counter-insurgency operations. Aug 2026.

questions.q: India's free trade agreement with which country came into force on 20 October 2026?
questions.why: Signed on 27 April 2026; all Indian exports get duty-free access. Oct 2026.

questions.q: On which date is World Osteoporosis Day observed?
questions.why: Coordinated by the International Osteoporosis Foundation; 2026 campaign: build, protect, strengthen your bones. Oct 2026.

questions.q: Exercise KONKAN-26, held off Plymouth with INS Trishul in October 2026, is a naval exercise between India and:
questions.why: The Royal Navy fielded the frigate HMS Sutherland. Oct 2026.
